Method of Attack: Exploiting unauthenticated stack buffer overflow leading to remote code execution
Backdoor enabling listing and password change of user accounts
Impacted Systems: Video surveillance equipment from over 100 camera brands and more than 2,500 camera models
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of unauthenticated stack buffer overflow (Peekaboo vulnerability CVE-2018-1149)
Local network presence required for backdoor exploitation (CVE-2018-1150)
